definitions.explanation: A quality or trait considered morally good or admirable. Can refer to both personal virtues and values prized by a society or culture.

examples.japanese: {忍耐|にんたい}は{美徳|びとく}だ。
{謙虚|けんきょ}さは{日本|にほん}で{大切|たいせつ}にされる{美徳|びとく}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: Humility is one of the virtues valued in Japan.

examples.japanese: {勤勉|きんべん}さを{美徳|びとく}とする{文化|ぶんか}では、{長時間|ちょうじかん}{働|はたら}くことが{当然|とうぜん}とされがちだ。
examples.english: In cultures that consider diligence a virtue, working long hours tends to be taken for granted.

notes:
{美徳|びとく} refers to a morally admirable quality or trait. It combines {美|び} (beauty) + {徳|とく} (virtue, morality).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～は{美徳|びとく}だ: ~ is a virtue
- ～を{美徳|びとく}とする: to regard ~ as a virtue
- {美徳|びとく}とされる: to be considered a virtue
- {最大|さいだい}の{美徳|びとく}: the greatest virtue

JAPANESE VIRTUES OFTEN DISCUSSED:
- {謙虚|けんきょ}さ: humility
- {忍耐|にんたい}: patience, perseverance
- {勤勉|きんべん}さ: diligence
- {礼儀正|れいぎただ}しさ: politeness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美徳|びとく}: virtue (positive quality)
- {悪徳|あくとく}: vice (negative quality)
